_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the headline proof numbers. Edit this file and nothing else, then run sh/check-stats.sh and follow what it tells you. Full instructions: HOW-TO-UPDATE-THE-NUMBERS.md in this folder. These numbers are also consumed by the Executive Navigants landing page, in a separate repo, over https://www.imagineers.ai/stats.json.

hours.label: hours each of hands-on GenAI use

_PRICES: The two course fees. A stat with a prefix is a fee, not a count: the prefix is written in the HTML but never in the JSON-LD offer, which takes bare digits. Do not put a comma in value; the code inserts it where the surrounding text already uses one.

price.label: per person incl VAT, open enrolment

priceInHouse.label: per private cohort ex VAT, up to fifteen delegates

_DATES: Two dates, and they mean different things. verified is when the headline figures above were last checked against the records. reviewed is when the site copy was last gone over, and it is what the footer shows on every page. Both are plain strings, so apply-stats writes them into any data-stat slot that names them and never tries to do arithmetic on them.
